label: Bible Study
prompt: And Peter went out, and wept _____.
verse: And Peter went out, and wept bitterly.
note: The rooster crowed, the Lord turned and looked at Peter — and these were his tears.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his _____, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
verse: And now, brethren, I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace, which is able to build you up, and to give you an inheritance among all them which are sanctified.
note: Paul's farewell to the Ephesian elders leaves them in the best hands: God and the word of His grace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child _____ seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
verse: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
note: The Shunammite's son came back to life with seven sneezes — the only time 'sneezed' appears in the KJV.

label: Deep Water
prompt: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon _____.
verse: He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.
note: Job pictures the earth hanging on nothing — a striking image for an ancient poet.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: _____ one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
verse: Forbearing one another, and forgiving one another, if any man have a quarrel against any: even as Christ forgave you, so also do ye.
note: 'Forbearing one another' — putting up with each other — and forgiving, even as Christ forgave you.
